example.title: Westin Long Beach (1983), 333 East Ocean Boulevard
example.place: Long Beach, Los Angeles County, CA

brief: A 1983 waterfront hotel: a sixteen-storey curved slab clad in bands of gold-tinted glass alternating with tan precast spandrels, a lit name box on the crown, beside a plaza of stepped fountains and palms on the convention-centre promenade. Two photos. Foundations taken deeper than needed (spec rule 4).
